FX-TW-001.says: As added: Pixel Motion at Speed 50. Frame 0 is the first drawing (the source time, a quarter frame before the in point, held there); frames 1, 2 and 5 are made a quarter, three quarters and a quarter of the way between drawings.

FX-TW-002.says: Whole Frames at Speed 50: each drawing shown twice, no new pictures.

FX-TW-003.says: Frame Mix at Speed 50: the two drawings either side faded together.

FX-TW-004.says: Speed 100: the layer exactly as it is.

FX-TW-005.says: Speed 200: twice as fast, made halfway between drawings 3 and 4 at frame 1; from frame 3 on it holds the last drawing.

FX-TW-006.says: Speed keyed from 200 at frame 0 down to 0 at frame 4: it slows to a stop at source time 4.5.

FX-TW-007.says: Source Frame keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 5 at frame 4: frame 1 shows source frame 1.25 and frame 2 shows 2.5.

FX-TW-008.says: Source Frame 3.5, Frame Mix: halfway between drawings 4 and 5 on every frame.

FX-TW-009.says: Build From One Image: a quarter of the way uses the drawing before only, three quarters the drawing after only.

FX-TW-010.says: Error Threshold 0: never mixed toward Frame Mix.

FX-TW-011.says: Error Threshold 10: wherever the two warped pictures disagree, mixed toward Frame Mix.

FX-TW-012.says: Filtering Extreme: the warped pictures read by the cubic.

FX-TW-013.says: Correct Luminance Changes on, on the textured card, whose mean brightness changes as it slides.

FX-TW-014.says: Tuning changed: Vector Detail 100, Global Smoothness 1, Local Smoothness 0, 8 iterations, Block Size 4, weights 1, 0 and 0.

FX-TW-015.says: Motion Blur on, Automatic, with the composition's 180 degrees in 8 samples (its switch off): the moments spread a quarter frame of source time.

FX-TW-016.says: Motion Blur on, Manual, 360 degrees in 4 samples, Whole Frames at Speed 200: drawings 2, 3, 3 and 4 averaged, the source times 1.75, 2.25, 2.75 and 3.25.

FX-TW-017.says: Motion Blur on, Manual, 360 degrees in 4 samples, Frame Mix on keyed Source Frame.

FX-TW-018.says: Motion Blur on, Manual, 0 degrees: as with it off.

FX-TW-020.says: An Exposure of +1 before Timewarp: the frames it reads are brightened too.

FX-TW-021.says: An Exposure of -1 after Timewarp darkens its picture.

FX-TW-022.says: The layer's in point at frame 2: its source time starts there.

FX-TW-023.says: The holder moved 3 right and 2 down: FX-TW-001 moved.

FX-TW-024.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder: nothing changes, and the frame says why.

FX-TW-025.says: Drawings on twos at Speed 50: between two frames of one drawing nothing moves, so that drawing shows exactly.

FX-TW-026.says: Speed -100: the source time runs back from the in point, held at the first drawing.

FX-TW-027.says: Speed 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TW-028.says: Method written "optical". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TW-029.says: Error Threshold -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TW-030.says: Smoothing Iterations 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TW-031.says: Red Weight 2, above 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TW-032.says: Filtering written "sinc". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TW-033.says: Shutter Samples keyed to 100 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
